name: rightsize
description: Right-sizes each Claude Code prompt: rates the effort, model and cost it needs, then lowers or raises effort, or hands the work to a stronger or cheaper subagent, the way you chose the first time each case came up. It scores Haiku's ratings against what happened, with a Sonnet spot-check and your 👍 and 👎, and stops trusting them where they keep missing

floor.title: Lowest effort
floor.description: The lowest effort level rightsize will lower to.

billing.title: Reports
billing.description: api: subagent reports show dollars. subscription: they show the share of usage and of the 5-hour window, with API-equivalent dollars beside it. Read off each response's rate limits when they show it; setting it here counts as your answer when they don't.

handOff.title: Hand-off threshold
handOff.description: Send a big task to a cheaper subagent only when it is estimated to cost under this share of staying on your model, counting the brief, check and likely rework. Lower is stricter.

lowering.title: Lowering threshold
lowering.description: Lower effort only when the lower level is estimated to cost under this share of staying, counting the cache it may rewrite. Lower is stricter.

subagents.title: Claude's subagents
subagents.description: cheaper when it fits: when Claude starts a general-purpose subagent without naming a model, rate its brief and run it on the cheapest weaker model that fits, at that model's level, under the hand-off threshold. off: leave Claude's own subagents on its model.

pacing.title: Budget pacing
pacing.description: on: on a subscription, move the thresholds by how fast the 5-hour and 7-day windows are being used. Running out early: hand off and lower more readily. Much left near a reset: hand off only for big savings, and raise without asking. Over 90% used: save all it can and skip raises. off: always use the thresholds above.

escalation.title: Raise when stuck
escalation.description: on: when a turn shows Claude is stuck (the same tool call failing twice, 3 tool calls failing, the same call running 3 times, or 3x the rated steps), raise effort one level for the rest of the turn, at most twice and never to max. It follows your Raising rule: automatic raises without asking, otherwise it asks. off: never raise mid-turn.

share.title: Share anonymous feedback
share.description: on: send anonymous numbers to the rightsize author, at most once an hour, to tune its defaults: task types, models, effort levels, rated levels, token guesses, estimated and real costs, what went wrong, Sonnet checks, and your 👍 and 👎, with a random install id. Never prompts, code, file names, paths, tool or server names, or session ids. Only what is logged after you turn it on is sent. off (default): nothing is sent; turning it off and on again starts a new install id.

startTips.title: Start suggestions
startTips.description: on: once a week, estimate what the last 30 days of rated prompts would have cost from Sonnet and Opus at medium and high, rightsize's changes counted. Prompts Haiku's rating has often got wrong for a model count against that model's start. When another start is at least 15% cheaper (25% while it has few measured runs) without sending over 1 prompt in 10 to a stronger model, or when over 15% of prompts needed a stronger model or more effort, the band suggests switching with /model. rightsize never changes your model itself. off: no suggestions; /rightsize report still shows the comparison.

raterCheck.title: Rater check
raterCheck.description: on: on every 50th rated prompt, ask Sonnet in the background to rate the same prompt, and log where it says a model would struggle that Haiku said does the work. These checks, rework on hand-offs, lowered turns that stepped back up, mid-turn raises and your 👍 and 👎 give a miss rate per task type and model; at 30% rightsize stops handing that work down to that model and stops lowering effort on it. Each check costs one Sonnet call and never delays the prompt. off: no checks (the other outcomes still count).

idleWarning.title: Idle warning
idleWarning.description: When a session under 200K tokens sat idle past the cache's life (1 hour, or 5 minutes when prices.json says 5m), ask before the next prompt writes the whole conversation to the cache again, when that costs over this much more than a warm cache. You can send it or hold it to /clear or /compact first. On a subscription the bar is in API-equivalent dollars, and the question gives the cost as a share of the 5-hour window once runs show the rate.

band.title: Band
band.description: The row above the prompt that shows what rightsize did, with buttons to undo it, mark a hand-off or lowering 👍 or 👎 (kept on this machine) or change the rule. when it acts: only when it changes something. always: on every rated prompt, no change included. off: status line only.

priceCheck.title: Price check
priceCheck.description: monthly: compare prices.json with Anthropic's pricing page every 30 days and update it. check now: check once right away, then back to monthly. off: never check.
